title: groundstation field test №11: the same 20 asks, run again on the fixed code
heading: THE FIELD TEST №11
sub: groundstation · 20 prompts · 19 live artifacts · 0 fixed · 20 same · 0 newly broken · October 25, 2026 · Development Seed labs
lede: The 20 prompts from field test №10, same words and same roles, run again live and in-process on main at 0.20.1, after the day's fixes merged (answers lead with the answer, data behind "show the data", per-origin tile cache keys). Each card's learning says how it compares with №10: 0 fixed, 20 the same, 0 newly broken. That is the honest result: today's merged fixes changed how the answers read and how map tiles load on a phone, not what the tools return, so every stumble from №10 is still here. The "same" cards are the next stops: clipping statistics to the place asked about, a geocoder that says when it is unsure, and empty or timed-out results that never read as all-clear. The first of those, clipping, landed as 0.21.0 the same night, after this run; №12 will show it. A field test is a showcase, not CI: it shows what the tools do today.

cases.answer: The newest radar scene is 2026-10-21 and covers the whole area (covers_aoi_pct 100.0), though valid_percent is 83.46, so about a sixth of the box holds no data.
